name: The Phenomenals
source:
Join The Phenomenals, a team of sexy superheroes dedicated to protecting their fellow 'phenoms' – people with unique powers who are hated and feared by the masses.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
加入The Phenomenals，这是一支由性感超级英雄组成的团队，致力于保护他们的“天才”同胞——拥有独特力量、被大众憎恨和恐惧的人。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
